migration_flags.description: analytic_account_id is ABSENT on purchase.order.line in v19. Field replaced by analytic_distribution JSON dict via analytic.mixin. Migration must convert legacy single-account FK to JSON distribution format {account_id_str: percentage}.
No 'done' state on purchase.order in v19 Community base module. Any code or migration assertion checking for state='done' will silently fail. Terminal confirmed state is 'purchase'.
receipt_status field (pending/partial/full) is defined in purchase_stock extension, not base purchase. SMEsPlus must confirm purchase_stock is installed before any code references receipt_status.
effective_date (arrival date) is defined in purchase_stock extension. Base purchase module has no such field. Three-date semantics (date_order, date_approve, effective_date) span two modules.

invoice_status is 'no' for all orders not in state 'purchase'. Pre-confirmation billing status checks always return 'no' regardless of bill activity. Migration data checks must exclude non-purchase-state orders.

partner_ref (vendor reference) is NOT propagated to vendor bill ref or origin. Bill origin receives the internal PO name. Any migration expecting partner_ref on the bill must add this logic explicitly.

purchase.group_purchase_manager unconditionally bypasses the po_double_validation_amount threshold. Migrated user group assignments must preserve this bypass or approval flows will break for manager users.

key_findings.state_machine: Five states: draft/sent/to approve/purchase/cancel; no 'done' in v19 Community; button_confirm routes to immediate approval or 'to approve' intermediary based on _approval_allowed()
key_findings.invoice_status: Computed in base purchase module; 'no' unless state=purchase; three values: no/to invoice/invoiced; qty_to_invoice drives status and is purchase_method-dependent (ordered vs received)
key_findings.receipt_status: Defined in purchase_stock extension ONLY; three values: pending/partial/full; driven by picking states not by move quantities
key_findings.is_shipped: Boolean in purchase_stock; True when all pickings are done or cancel; False if no pickings
key_findings.effective_date: In purchase_stock; earliest done-picking date_done excluding supplier-return destinations
key_findings.bill_creation: action_create_invoice groups by vendor+currency; sets invoice_origin=PO.name; qty_to_invoice determines line quantities; negative total auto-converts to refund
key_findings.analytic_migration: analytic_account_id ABSENT; analytic_distribution JSON via analytic.mixin; _validate_analytic_distribution called in button_confirm
key_findings.approval_flow: one_step bypasses threshold; two_step checks amount vs po_double_validation_amount; group_purchase_manager always bypasses
key_findings.partner_ref: Vendor's own reference number; used as secondary matching key for EDI/OCR bill matching; not propagated to bill header
